handhold_actual_c31_CAD.source: Final C31 R1.70 primary CAD snapshot; independently summed moving part masses and exact BREP centroids; source hashes identify snapshot
handhold_actual_c31_CAD.formula: gravity moment = W*(dx*cos(theta)-dz*sin(theta)); tangential hand force = moment/hypot(19.5,-1); vertical force uses instantaneous horizontal grip arm 19.5*cos(theta)+sin(theta)
handhold_actual_c31_CAD.limits: Quasistatic rigid-moving-plus-padding gravity only. Flexible curtain/cable behavior, friction, acceleration, misalignment, posture and ergonomic qualification additional. Hand force is total at both grips combined, not per grip. No unattended intermediate position.
